title: Persistent Theme Implementation
summary: Building a robust dark/light mode toggle.
content: To implement the theme switcher, I utilized JavaScript's localStorage API. When a user clicks the toggle button, it updates a data-theme attribute on the body tag and saves the selection to localStorage. This ensures the preference persists across page reloads.

title: Dynamic JSON Data Fetching
summary: Rendering blog posts natively from JSON.
content: Using the Fetch API, I retrieved data from posts.json. I mapped the array of objects into the DOM using document.createElement. The main challenge was dynamically formatting the JavaScript Date object and sorting the array from newest to oldest before rendering.

title: Client-Side Form Validation
content: I intercepted the form submission event using e.preventDefault(). I wrote a RegEx pattern to validate the email, and checked if the textarea string length was >= 20 characters. I bound a focus/input event to instantly clear error messages when the user corrects their typo.

title: Real-time DOM Filtering
content: By attaching an 'input' event listener to a search box, I matched the user's string against the title and category DOM elements inside my cards. If no matches return, a tracking variable triggers a 'No results found' paragraph to display.
